notes.title: The official soundtrack for Cat And Ghostly Road
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34329928/ffdfc84d9b3f8e3139adaeabcd2b76810e0f1fc5.jpg[/img]
The official soundtrack for Cat And Ghostly Road immerses the listener in the mystical world of the game. Compositions are created in oriental style. Most tunes are looped and can be played for hours.

The Cat And Ghostly Road Soundtrack is composed by BOV.

notes.title: We are released!
notes.notes:

We thank everyone who supported us in the early access phase and bought the game.
Thank you for believing in our game!
We thank you for your feedback and advice.

- added a lot of sounds and music
- English is better in the game
